rules.clause_label: Restrictions on use of software and source code
rules.scope_note: Applies to the software and its source code, in whole or in part. These lines state no affirmative grant; copying, modification, distribution, or use is prohibited unless the author gives express written permission.
rules.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the user has not obtained the author's express written permission.
rules.source_excerpt:
Unauthorised copying, modification, distribution, or use of this
software, in whole or in part, without the express written permission
of the author is strictly prohibited.
